name: [💀] Dont Fall To Acid
desc:
Advance across disappearing platforms as the acid rises relentlessly.

The further you progress, the more money you'll earn 💰 to boost your speed, reduce your time, and respawn to go even further.

🔥 Fast-paced and addictive gameplay
⚡ Improve your stats
🔁 Rebirth for faster progress
🏆 Compete on the leaderboard

👉 How far can you go without falling?
